	Knowledge of research software, reference-management tools, or electronic health-record systems.


What we offer


	Competitive salary and benefits package.
	The opportunity to contribute to meaningful clinical research and medical education.
	Professional development opportunities in clinical research and health education.

Research Associate Job at Lily Hospitals Limited




        
    

        
        Lily Hospitals Limited, established since 1986 remains one of the foremost hospitals in Nigeria and within the South-South region of the country. It is the first private hospital in Nigeria to achieve ISO 9001:2000 quality management system certification from the Standards Organization of Nigeria (SON). Also, we are consistently committed to high standards: continuous improvement, service excellence, organizational citizenship, and an outstanding work ethic.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Research Associate 
Job Location: Warri, Delta
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a highly organised and motivated Research Associate to support clinical research activity and the coordination of our medical residency programme.
	The successful candidate will work with clinicians, researchers, residents, and administrative teams to help deliver high-quality research and an excellent training experience for resident doctors.


Key responsibilities


	Support the coordination of clinical research studies, including maintaining study records, preparing documentation, tracking timelines, and assisting with ethics and governance submissions.
	Conduct literature reviews and prepare clear research summaries, reports, presentations, and briefing materials.
	Help collect, organise, and manage research data in line with hospital policies, ethics requirements, and data-protection standards.
	Support resident onboarding, rotation schedules, teaching sessions, assessments, and programme communications.
	Act as a point of contact for residents, supervising consultants, research teams, and external partners.
	Coordinate research meetings, journal clubs, educational events, workshops, and resident activities.
	Maintain accurate records relating to resident attendance, training requirements, research participation, and programme outcomes.
	Assist with grant applications, publications, audit projects, and dissemination of research findings where appropriate.
	Identify opportunities to improve research processes and the resident learning experience.


Requirements


	A Bachelor's Degree in Health Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, or a related field with 3-5 years of experience.
	Experience supporting research, clinical administration, medical education, or programme coordination.
	Strong research, writing, organisational, and administrative skills.
	Ability to manage confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
	Excellent communication skills and confidence working with multidisciplinary clinical teams.
	Knowledge of research software, reference-management tools, or electronic health-record systems.


What we offer


	Competitive salary and benefits package.
	The opportunity to contribute to meaningful clinical research and medical education.
	Professional development opportunities in clinical research and health education.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and relevant credentials to: [email protected] using "Research Associate" as the subject of the email.

Account Officer Job at Prince O J Global Services Limited




        
    

        
        Prince O J Global Services Limited is a fast consumer goods company incorporated in Nigeria with head office in Onitsha Anambra state, We deal on importation and distribution of top quality wines and spirits, spices, tomato, spaghetti, oil, margarine, baking powder, liquid milk and many more.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Account Officer

Job Location: Onitsha, Anambra
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Daily sales supervision
	Financial recording and bookkeeping
	Analysis and Advisory
	Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements
	Prepare and maintain detailed documentation


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree or HND in accounting field.
	Must have an accounting background
	Must be computer literate
	Must reside in Onitsha if you are applying for Onitsha
	Must reside in Awka if you are applying for Awka
	Proven experience in Accounting, preferably in FMCG Company
	Strong leadership skills and the ability to effectively manage a team
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills
	Ability to build and maintain long-lasting customer relationships
	Goal-oriented mindset and a driven personality
	Self-motivated and results-driven with a strong work ethic
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.


Salary
N80,000 - N100,000 per month. 

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position and Location as the subject of the mail.

  "description": "Rand Merchant Bank (RMB), a division of FirstRand Bank Limited, is a leading African corporate and investment bank and part of one of the largest financial services groups in Africa. We offer our clients innovative, value-added advisory, funding, trading, corporate banking and principal investing solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Operational Risk Analyst

Job ID: R53668
Job Location: Lagos

Job Description


	Risk and Compliance Department is responsible for the end-to-end management and oversight of all categories of risk and governance in RMB Nigeria.
	The risk function within the entity is not only an oversight function but is expected to get involved in the day-to-day functional reporting and management processes insofar as there are no conflicts of interest. This creates the opportunity for broad based integration into the business.


Responsibilities


	The successful candidate will primarily be focused on providing operational support to the ORM in ensuring the overall operational risk objectives are met. This will include:&nbsp;


KRIs:


	Monitor entity-wide compliance in terms of capture and approvals by due dates and escalate gaps appropriately to the ORM
	Monitor and ensure all KRI breaches have requisite action plans in place.&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
	Support the ORM with organizing KRI setting or review sessions with businesses.&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;


PRCIA:


	Support the ORM with organizing PRICA setting or review sessions with businesses&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
	Monitor PRICA review calendar and prompt both the ORM and Businesses for reviews coming due reporting.&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
	Prepare operational risk reports as may be assigned by the ORM or CRO&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
	Ensure items that needed to be loaded on open pages such as loss events and PRCIA are promptly updated.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;


Others:


	Take on assignments as directed by the ORM or CRO&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
	Participate in governance meetings for OpRisk&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
	Log all operational risk incidents on OpenPages&nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
	Ensure all OpRisk event logs are reviewed and approved within stipulated timeframes&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
	Provide general administrative support in all OpRisk departmental activities&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;


Qualifications and Experience


	Candidates should have a relevant graduate degree and at least 2-5 years of work experience preferably having worked as an entry-level professional in investment banking, accounting, audit, management consulting, or related fields, and who is interested in working in a small team environment with a high degree of client contact.&nbsp;
	Experience in MS-Excel financial modeling, including detailed income statement forecasting and scenario analysis, capital structure modeling and M&amp;A modeling.&nbsp;&nbsp;


Competencies:&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;


	Personal
	Analysis and Attention to Detail
	Verbal and Written Communication
	Problem Solving
	Self-motivated to take on multiple tasks


Business:


	Business Acumen
	Organisational Awareness
	Anticipating and Managing Change
	Presentation and Facilitation


Functional:


	Understanding of Operational Risk Management
	Team player
	Strong attention to details


Human Relations Profile:


	Strong Character &amp; integrity are paramount.
	Self-confidence, with a pleasant personality&nbsp;
	Well organized/good time management capabilities/disciplined/detail oriented&nbsp;
	Self-starter able to work with minimal supervision.&nbsp;
	Strong work ethic and ability to operate in a fast-growing environment&nbsp;
	Flexible when necessary and ability to work effectively under pressure&nbsp;

Operational Risk Analyst Job at Rand Merchant Bank (RMB




        
    

        
        Rand Merchant Bank (RMB), a division of FirstRand Bank Limited, is a leading African corporate and investment bank and part of one of the largest financial services groups in Africa. We offer our clients innovative, value-added advisory, funding, trading, corporate banking and principal investing solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Operational Risk Analyst

Job ID: R53668
Job Location: Lagos

Job Description
     

            
    




	Risk and Compliance Department is responsible for the end-to-end management and oversight of all categories of risk and governance in RMB Nigeria.
	The risk function within the entity is not only an oversight function but is expected to get involved in the day-to-day functional reporting and management processes insofar as there are no conflicts of interest. This creates the opportunity for broad based integration into the business.


Responsibilities


	The successful candidate will primarily be focused on providing operational support to the ORM in ensuring the overall operational risk objectives are met. This will include: 


KRIs:


	Monitor entity-wide compliance in terms of capture and approvals by due dates and escalate gaps appropriately to the ORM
	Monitor and ensure all KRI breaches have requisite action plans in place.    
	Support the ORM with organizing KRI setting or review sessions with businesses.    


PRCIA:


	Support the ORM with organizing PRICA setting or review sessions with businesses    
	Monitor PRICA review calendar and prompt both the ORM and Businesses for reviews coming due reporting.    
	Prepare operational risk reports as may be assigned by the ORM or CRO    
	Ensure items that needed to be loaded on open pages such as loss events and PRCIA are promptly updated.   


Others:


	Take on assignments as directed by the ORM or CRO    
	Participate in governance meetings for OpRisk    
	Log all operational risk incidents on OpenPages     
	Ensure all OpRisk event logs are reviewed and approved within stipulated timeframes    
	Provide general administrative support in all OpRisk departmental activities    


Qualifications and Experience


	Candidates should have a relevant graduate degree and at least 2-5 years of work experience preferably having worked as an entry-level professional in investment banking, accounting, audit, management consulting, or related fields, and who is interested in working in a small team environment with a high degree of client contact. 
	Experience in MS-Excel financial modeling, including detailed income statement forecasting and scenario analysis, capital structure modeling and M&A modeling.  


Competencies:       


	Personal
	Analysis and Attention to Detail
	Verbal and Written Communication
	Problem Solving
	Self-motivated to take on multiple tasks


Business:


	Business Acumen
	Organisational Awareness
	Anticipating and Managing Change
	Presentation and Facilitation


Functional:


	Understanding of Operational Risk Management
	Team player
	Strong attention to details


Human Relations Profile:


	Strong Character & integrity are paramount.
	Self-confidence, with a pleasant personality 
	Well organized/good time management capabilities/disciplined/detail oriented 
	Self-starter able to work with minimal supervision. 
	Strong work ethic and ability to operate in a fast-growing environment 
	Flexible when necessary and ability to work effectively under pressure
